messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: p99 latency breached for customer AsterionTech in eu-west-1 (dedicated pool). p99 = 2400ms (SLO 500ms). Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Event INC-2890-ORC. Paging on-call now.
li (on-call SRE): ack — joining warroom. oncall: li.
ops-bot: PagerDuty: li acknowledged. Incident severity: P2. Autotriage tags: latency, kv_cache_miss, dedicated-pool-eu-west-1.
samir (infra): looking at host metrics — node CPU at 92% on gpu-nodes-*. KV cache hit rate dropped sharply 20 -> 4%. I see a sudden spike of long-sequence requests from tenant asterion-batch-job (bursting at ~120rps). Logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] request_id=abc123 route=/v1/chat tenant=asterion-batch-job seq_len=4096 kv_cache_miss=0.88 latency_ms=2100
[2026-03-15T09:12:05Z] request_id=abc124 route=/v1/generate tenant=interactive-frontend seq_len=128 kv_cache_miss=0.06 latency_ms=450
```
samir (infra): batch job is saturating KV memory and causing cache thrash for interactive users.
kevin (runtime): initial mitigation options: 1) throttle/limit batch tenant; 2) spin up warm spare capacity in eu-central; 3) route interactive traffic to smaller model variant w/ lower mem footprint; 4) disable long batching for interactive route.
jess (CS): I’m on the line with AsterionTech support. They report user complaints in EU region for their product. I’ll update them: ETA 15–20m for mitigation. Can we get a quick containment? :pray:
li (on-call SRE): Action plan: A) isolate asterion-batch-job by applying rate-limit at edge immediately. B) add 4 GPUs to dedicated pool (hot-add) and shift interactive traffic to warm nodes. C) apply model-fallback for /v1/chat to model:asterion-llm-quant-1b as temporary. D) monitor p95/p99 and KV hit-rate.
kevin (runtime): implementing A and C now. Edge rule (edgectl):
```
edgectl policies apply --tenant asterion-batch-job --rule "rate_limit: 20rps" --reason "incident INC-2890-ORC"
```
kevin (runtime): applying model fallback for interactive route:
```
redwood route update --route "/v1/chat" --fallback-model "model:asterion-llm-quant-1b" --strategy immediate
```
vendor-bot: DedicatedPool autoscaler reached soft limit (pool=eu-west-1-dedicated-42). Requesting quota increase or warm spare allocation.
samir (infra): hot-add +4 GPUs started — nodes being provisioned (aws/gpu-scaleup job 5773). ETA ~7m.
li (on-call SRE): also disabling large-request batching on interactive route to reduce head-of-line blocking:
```
redwood config set --route "/v1/chat" batching.enabled=false --reason "latency mitigation INC-2890-ORC"
```
jess (CS): messaging update to AsterionTech: "We see an internal throttling and are taking steps to reduce impact. Expected user-visible improvement within ~10–20 minutes. We'll follow up when p99 back to normal"
kevin (runtime): note — fallback model increases token cost per token but reduces memory pressure; should reduce KV churn.
ops-bot: Event timeline updated, incident assigned to li, severity P2. All hands: please post progress here.
samir (infra): KV cache hit-rate recovering after rate-limit — now 46% (was 4%). p95 ~ 210ms, p99 trending down.
li (on-call SRE): p99 snapshot: 1) before mitigations 2400ms 2) after rate-limit + fallback + batching off + scaleup -> 520ms. Still slightly above SLO but much improved. Continue monitoring.
jess (CS): AsterionTech on call says traffic pattern includes scheduled nightly analytics — we'll ask them to pause jobs until we stabilise. Sending instructions to their infra team now.
kevin (runtime): follow-up config: enable automatic fallback policy to eu-central warm spare for interactive route when p99>700ms:
```
redwood routing set --route "/v1/chat" --failover-region eu-central-1 --threshold-p99 700
```
li (on-call SRE): a few followups before close: - coordinate with CS to confirm batch jobs paused - request quota increase for eu-west-1 pool or recommend dedicated reserved capacity for their heavy analytics - create post-incident runbook item to detect long-sequence job bursts.
jess (CS): customer paused the nightly job. They appreciate the temporary fallback and the clear ETA. Asking for a follow-up call after incident.
ops-bot: Observability: p99 graph link: https://console.redwood.example/incident/INC-2890-ORC/graphs (internal).
samir (infra): rolling restart not needed. nodes healthy. Hot-add completed at +4 GPUs.
li (on-call SRE): final status at 09:45 UTC — p99 = 480ms, p95 = 190ms, KV hit-rate = 72%. Incident moving to monitoring state. Recommend: postmortem, add surge policy for batch jobs, and tenant-level quotas for dedicated pools.
jess (CS): communicating resolution to AsterionTech; they requested a post-incident review.
kevin (runtime): created follow-up ticket: RWI-4234 (add tenant quota enforcement).
ops-bot: INC-2890-ORC status: mitigated -> monitoring. Closing warroom in 30m if stable. :white_check_mark:
